**Source:** `/Users/jinleic/repos/aifours/institute/runs/three-area-2026-10-27-96h/review-waves/f763-ame49-t28-independent-exact-local-component-author/finite-exact-t28-local-v1.py`  
**SHA-256:** `fce9bae825b344b049f09f44bf44f1c71e5e20c778f35ef5051d39481b5b0c74`  
**Size:** 36,805 bytes; 836 LF.

The source was created once, exclusively. It was **not run, imported, compiled or tested** in the child. Its guards, counts, mutants and rational-unitary control are therefore **design claims, not observed results**. Parent must read the entire pinned source and issue a separate GO before any single supervised run. The source specifies a 45-second cooperative deadline and a maximum 55-second external ceiling.

### Intended finite coverage

- All 560 labeled 13-entry \(4\times4\) supports, with necessary conditions in both orientations: line degrees, singleton overlaps, degree-two twins, isolation and connectivity; matched A/B types.
- All 28 six-vertex binary-cube slices and 56 five-vertex subsets; weighted 2-regular high-pair graphs, including the two-\(K_{2,2}\) and eight-cycle alternatives.
- All labeled admissible 4444 cut/H subgraphs, an explicitly relaxed P-word packing calculation, independent sets and the \((21,52,70)\) incidence moments.
- For 3344: all nine missing stars, admissible \(2\times2\) rectangles, outside-\(L\) cells, weighted high-pair models, compatible component supports and labeled low-component assignments. The code applies actual partner-degree, multiplicity and other-cut necessary conditions to the same local E words.
- For 3444: bounded degree/\(n_a\) profiles, low-sector supports, all 560 thirteen-word binary-sector supports, and labeled H=0/1/2 high-pair scenarios. Reason-specific mutants are included throughout.
- A from-scratch rational **one-cut** unitary control, with integer numerator
  \[
  \begin{pmatrix}
  0&0&75&100\\
  0&75&-80&60\\
  75&-80&-48&36\\
  -100&-60&-36&27
  \end{pmatrix}/125,
  \]
  for which the source checks both integer Grams against \(125^2I\). It is not an AME witness.

### Written observation: the 3444 H=0 low sector

Under the stated H=0 synchronization and actual pair-line premises, \(n_a=2\) is impossible. Each low-symbol pair line has two E words. If exactly two low-sector words have \(A=a\), then at each of the three q4 parties they must use the same low symbol; otherwise each used \((a,\text{low})\) line would have only one word. The two words would consequently be the same four-coordinate word.

Thus the only possible low-sector occupancy pattern is \((4,4,0)\). A degree-three symbol with \(n_a=4\) has exactly one high partner at each q4 party; synchronized high status fixes the entire complementary high triple, which cannot supply the required two distinct words. This eliminates degree profile 233. For 224, the degree-four symbol and the degree-two symbol with \(n_a=0\) are the two high-sector A symbols; together with the q4 high symbols they give all-six-pair closure. The final contradiction still **imports the separately written no-four-qubit-AME lemma**. This argument and its implementation require independent parent scrutiny; they are not a parent disposition.

### Boundary and counterargument

The enumeration uses necessary support and incidence conditions, not arbitrary complex phases, a complete P-set construction or a global AME enumeration. A surviving local configuration would be a counterargument to the *encoded necessary-condition exclusion*, **not** an AME witness. Conversely, an empty finite search would corroborate only the precisely encoded local premises and their coverage. The global \(t\leq28\) chain, the proposed minimum-50 composition, witness replay, novelty, source identity and parent adoption remain outside this return.

### Intake and provenance

Actual dispatch was read first. Before the body, I read the manifest, freeze receipt, final binding, prepared metadata and all **22** controls through their endings, then sent Main a direct pre-body acknowledgement. The sole 306-LF packet was subsequently read serially in raw windows of at most 20 LF through its ending. No outgoing source links, held episodes or consumers, old code, or unspecified sibling proofs were read. An initial typo in the f586 control path was retried successfully before the acknowledgement; no new process fault is known. This is not a cognitive-isolation certification.
